verdict.rationale: Daytona documents an official CLI that manages core sandbox features, including lifecycle and snapshots (daytona-docs-12), and a probe confirms the CLI docs page is live (daytona-probe-5). Its official agent skill bundles CLI patterns alongside the SDKs (daytona-docs-35), which ties the CLI directly to agent workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI behaviour such as machine-readable output and non-interactive auth, depth on command coverage beyond the summary line, and independent hands-on corroboration of the current CLI.
